caption: The drawing depicts a full-length statue of a man standing on an ornate pedestal. The man is dressed in formal attire, including light-colored pants, a matching vest, and a cloak or robe that drapes over his shoulders and extends down to his feet; the cloak is predominantly colored blue with darker shading. He holds a rolled-up document in his right hand and a cylindrical hat in his left hand. The pedestal beneath his feet features scroll-like carvings and dark, wavy lines. The background of the image is plain, with the statue and pedestal centrally positioned. The artwork is rendered in a combination of blue, grey, and beige tones, with black outlines and details. The bottom right corner contains a small monogram or signature consisting of the letters "W."
title: Figurehead: "Andrew Jackson"
